Configuration

Configure RoselineMCP to suit your development needs.

Environment Variables

RoselineMCP can be configured using environment variables:

Variable Description Default
ROSELINE_LOG_LEVEL Logging level (Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error) Information
ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT Environment (Development, Production) Production

Configuration Files

appsettings.json

The main configuration file:

{
  "Logging": {
    "LogLevel": {
      "Default": "Information",
      "RoselineMCP": "Debug",
      "Microsoft": "Warning"
    }
  }
}

Environment-Specific Configuration

Create environment-specific files:

  • appsettings.Development.json
  • appsettings.Production.json

MCP Integration

Claude Desktop Configuration

Configure in claude_desktop_config.json:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "roseline": {
      "command": "dotnet",
      "args": ["run", "--project", "/path/to/RoselineMCP.csproj"],
      "env": {
        "ROSELINE_LOG_LEVEL": "Debug"
      }
    }
  }
}

Docker Configuration

When running in Docker:

docker run -e ROSELINE_LOG_LEVEL=Debug phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest
